decisions.historicalRule: Optional assessment means ordinary XML is admitted without an assessor/origin. Retain ISchemaAssessmentInput as a neutral borrowed input; add bool OwnsNode(IXdmNode) before node getters. Never invent assessment evidence for XmlDb.
decisions.effectiveScope: Retain rule within exact revised packet scope; implementation and owner qualification remain pending.

decisions.title: Node-fact association
decisions.historicalRule: Retain OwnsNodeFacts and additionally verify the exact node/facts/input/origin association using the new advisor OwnsNode overload. Issued facts alone cannot authenticate another node.
decisions.effectiveScope: Retain rule within exact revised packet scope; implementation and owner qualification remain pending.

decisions.title: Source-specific typed values
decisions.historicalRule: ReadTypedValue requires a SchemaQuerySnapshot argument. Advisor OwnsTypedValue additionally receives admitted input and optional original assessment; issuance is checked before container getters. Fresh construction uses ConstructSimpleValue and does not mint original assessment.
decisions.effectiveScope: Retain rule within exact revised packet scope; implementation and owner qualification remain pending.

decisions.title: Bounded dynamic context
decisions.historicalRule: Retain Evaluate(EvaluationContext) and XSLT Transform context parameters, but capture supported data internally under the operation. Refuse unsupported services before evaluation. Do not publish a new arbitrary input-capture factory or silently use raw context.
decisions.effectiveScope: Retain rule within exact revised packet scope; implementation and owner qualification remain pending.

decisions.title: Host ownership and operation lifetime
decisions.historicalRule: Retain IQueryOperationLifetime/Lease and same-session immutable Run membership. Close revokes admissions; Drain waits for raw work. No provider/store disposal transfer or required Dispose on IXdmNode/sequence/managed assessed document. Host/provider must retain actual resources through raw work.
decisions.effectiveScope: Retain rule within exact revised packet scope; implementation and owner qualification remain pending.

decisions.title: All-host invocation
decisions.historicalRule: Retain separate match/global snapshot roles, explicit empty membership for source-free named templates, and one lease per unique admission. Initial document roots are the first bounded profile; modes, resource policies, arbitrary initial sequences and streaming refuse when not captured/supported. Broader required Braid signatures must be resolved before freeze.
decisions.effectiveScope: Apply exact revised BCAP proposal and role restrictions; historical narrower feasibility profile is not a prohibition on subsequently reviewed initial modes/capture.

decisions.title: Authority and identity
decisions.historicalRule: Retain opaque source/snapshot/assessment/component identities and owner membership checks. Complete closure and supported false/empty remain distinct from Unsupported. Descriptors, QNames and GUID equality never admit authority.
decisions.effectiveScope: Retain rule within exact revised packet scope; implementation and owner qualification remain pending.

decisions.title: Exact numeric representation
decisions.historicalRule: Retain XdmExactDecimal and all six XdmValue numeric member intents. Integrate arbitrary-precision parsing/arithmetic/casts/map keys/serialization before claiming support. Retain legacy signatures; wrong-kind checks remain, narrowing refuses overflow/inexact values. No annotation string issues authority.
decisions.effectiveScope: Retain rule within exact revised packet scope; implementation and owner qualification remain pending.

decisions.title: Atomic/list/union and original PSVI
decisions.historicalRule: Retain governing list/union shape and per-atomic selected type/provenance, including empty/singleton lists. Preserve original facts or explicitly strip. Nil/no-typed-value differ from empty typed value. Unsupported backend coverage is explicit and cannot remove required contract representation.
decisions.effectiveScope: Retain rule within exact revised packet scope; implementation and owner qualification remain pending.

decisions.title: Assessment and compatible views
decisions.historicalRule: Retain captured environment, advisor/episode, complete valid-only validated roots, diagnostics and directional compatible-view contracts. An unimplemented backend route returns Unsupported; compatibility is never inferred or fabricated. Positive supported profiles and intentional refusals need actual owner acceptance.
decisions.effectiveScope: Retain rule within exact revised packet scope; implementation and owner qualification remain pending.

decisions.title: Failure preservation
decisions.historicalRule: Retain original work/admission/cancellation failure first, then every cleanup failure in reverse release order, without flattening provider exception objects. XmlDb cleanup masking is an owner implementation/profile issue, not justification for a new Core disposal API.
decisions.effectiveScope: Retain rule within exact revised packet scope; implementation and owner qualification remain pending.

decisions.title: Finite limits and resource policy
decisions.historicalRule: Retain required positive finite query counts/numeric digits and nonnegative decimal scale; no workload defaults selected. Diagnostic limits and public record inputs require constructor/runtime validation. Captured resource policies must freeze or refuse mutable capabilities; no implicit source acquisition.
decisions.effectiveScope: Retain rule within exact revised packet scope; implementation and owner qualification remain pending.

decisions.title: Existing compatibility
decisions.historicalRule: Retain all existing public declarations/constants/defaults, optional node defaults and persistent format behavior unless a separately adopted semantic change explicitly says otherwise. No mandatory schema channel on legacy IXdmNode, no new required enumerator disposal member, and no XmlDb format migration.
decisions.effectiveScope: Retain rule within exact revised packet scope; implementation and owner qualification remain pending.

decisions.title: Performance and scope restraint
decisions.historicalRule: Require actual owner PF-01–09 workloads, budgets and default-path checks before freeze. Keep internal batching/caches private; no speculative public batch/cursor/group/acquisition SDK or proprietary licensing seam. Record any demonstrated remaining signature need before acceptance.
decisions.effectiveScope: Retain rule within exact revised packet scope; implementation and owner qualification remain pending.
